title: Country
description: data/<iso3>/country.yaml: a country and the parties its parliamentary groups can be made of.

id.description: Identifier that groups reference in their `parties` list, unique within the country. Never change it once published.

name.description: Full name of the party, in its own language.

partyfacts_id.description: The party's id in Party Facts (https://partyfacts.herokuapp.com/), when it has one. It is the only link this repository keeps to other datasets: Party Facts maps it to their own ids (expert surveys, election datasets...).
